mapper.select: SELECT id, delegator_id, delegate_id, start_at, end_at, max_value, currency, allowed_categories::text AS allowed_categories_json, scope, status, created_at FROM iam.delegations WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND id = #{id}

SELECT id, delegator_id, delegate_id, start_at, end_at, max_value, currency, allowed_categories::text AS allowed_categories_json, scope, status, created_at FROM iam.delegations WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND delegator_id = #{delegatorId} ORDER BY start_at DESC, created_at DESC
SELECT n.path FROM iam.users u JOIN iam.org_nodes n ON n.id = u.org_node_id AND n.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE u.is_deleted = FALSE AND u.id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam.delegations ( id, delegator_id, delegate_id, start_at, end_at, max_value, currency, allowed_categories, scope, status, created_by ) VALUES ( #{entity.id}, #{entity.delegatorId}, #{entity.delegateId}, #{entity.startAt}, #{entity.endAt}, #{entity.maxValue}, #{entity.currency}, CAST(#{entity.allowedCategoriesJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{entity.scope}, #{entity.status}, #{actorId} )
